label: PF Backlog 608
title: RCCA (process, P0): partial delivery reported as complete - EDP-02 closed without store classification/mapping; add artifact-completeness gates + evidence-based DoD + re-open audit

brief.what_adds: Artifact-completeness gates + evidence-based DoD + re-open/audit falsely-closed items so partial work cannot pass
brief.problem: Partial discovery work was reported/closed as complete (no classification/mapping), and nothing caught it

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend delivery/engineering-complete endpoints with a reusable artifact-completeness validator: per-lane required-artifact manifest (EDP-02 must include store classification + mapping) checked fail-closed before any 'complete' status persists. Derive the gate from a declarative manifest (config) rather than hardcoding. Wire re-open audit: log reopen events, record evidence references, and trigger auto-RCCA via existing /issues/{iid}/rcca flow (reuse BI-PF-1246 reconciliation).
dependency_findings: REQUIRES BI-PF-0448 fail-closed guard pattern in delivery lane (same code path)
RELATED BI-PF-1246 (reuse auto-RCCA on validation FAIL)
RELATED BI-PF-1292 EDP-02 (data plane) - defines which store classification artifacts exist
conflict_findings: core/delivery.py likely touched by BI-PF-1246/0448 - serialize or coordinate PRs
engineering complete endpoint may be modified by multiple gate items - centralize validator to avoid divergence
duplication_findings: BI-PF-1246 covers auto-RCCA on validation FAIL - reuse its reconciliation hook, do not reimplement RCCA creation
BI-PF-0448 covers fail-closed delivery context gates - align artifact gate with that gate family, share guard pattern
artifact_store/asset_store already track artifacts - reuse as evidence source, no new store
analysis.rationale: The gap is an enforcement hole, not a new capability: existing stores + delivery APIs can gate closures and record evidence with modest extension, reusing BI-PF-0448 guard pattern and BI-PF-1246 auto-RCCA. No new component needed.
assumptions: EDP-02 required artifacts = store classification doc + store mapping (per EDP-02 spec)
Re-open is an explicit audited action, not automatic revert without human/RCCA link
artifact_store/asset_store hold evidence with stable IDs usable as DoD references
risks: Manifest over-specification could block legitimate partial deliveries - needs lane-scoped rules
Existing completed items (EDP-02 already closed) lack artifacts - re-open triggers a backlog of remediation
Conflicts with in-flight delivery-gate work could cause merge churn
evidence: Candidate APIs include /delivery and /engineering/assignments/{item_id}/complete as closure points to gate
Existing stores (artifact_store, asset_store, forge_store) provide evidence backing for completeness checks
BI-PF-1246 already established validation-FAIL -> auto-RCCA pipeline to reuse
missing_info: Canonical list of required artifacts per work-item type/lane (especially EDP-02)
Whether historical closed items are auto re-opened or grandfathered
Who reviews re-open decisions (owner vs. governance board)
RCCA SLA and severity mapping for completeness failures

context_review.reason: Every field just repeats the title; no specifics on which artifacts are missing, what the completeness gates or evidence-based DoD should look like, no affected components/files, and no concrete acceptance criteria.

api_impact.reason: governance/infra/tooling change; no external API surface
